The '''Wood Path''' is a [[Crafting#Decor|crafted item]] used to create decorative paths. It can be displaced by lightning or destroyed by [[weeds]].

The recipe is already in the player's inventory when the game starts.

All types of pathing provide a +0.1 boost to [[Speed#Player Speed|Player Speed]], but only if placed outside the [[Farmhouse]] on [[the Farm]]. They also have the indirect benefit of preventing [[Grass]] or [[Trees]] from growing in heavily used areas, which would otherwise slow down or obstruct movement.
